question: What will be the Metacritic Metascore of Halo: Campaign Evolved on August 31, 2026?

factors.description: Firm July 28 2026 release, ~34 days before checkpoint: major Halo title will have an established Metascore with ample reviews.
Most-analogous comparable (CE Anniversary, same campaign) scored 82; broader Halo set 82-87.
Sprint/power-up controversy and missing original competitive multiplayer likely cost review points.
Strong UE5 visual praise could lift scores toward upper Halo range.

summary: Halo: Campaign Evolved is a UE5 ground-up remake of Halo: Combat Evolved's campaign, launching July 28, 2026 (early access July 23) — ~34 days before the Aug 31 checkpoint, so an established Xbox Metascore will exist. Anchor set of Halo remasters/sequels clusters tightly at 82-87 (CE Anniversary 82, MCC 85, Halo 4 87, Halo 5 84, Infinite Xbox 87). The most analogous comparable (CE Anniversary, same campaign remastered) scored 82. Verified criticisms — new sprint/run button, power-ups, and no original competitive multiplayer — add downside toward high-70s, while strong UE5 visual praise adds modest upside. Scenario mixture centers at 83 with an asymmetric downside tail.
reasoning:
Forecast submitted. **Median Metascore ≈ 83** for Halo: Campaign Evolved (Xbox), with an 80% CI of roughly 78–87.

Verified criticisms (sprint/power-up changes, no original competitive multiplayer) pull toward the high-70s, while UE5 visual praise adds modest upside, producing a center of 83 with an asymmetric downside tail.
